user.say: I need to book the same electrician who came last time. Can I get him this week? Anytime after 10 a.m. works for me.
Yes, the 11:00 am slot on Wednesday works perfectly. Please book that.

steps.text: I'll look up your past bookings to find that electrician.
Found him — Lakshmi Wiring Services, from your October visit. Setting up the errand.

input.ui:
root = Stack([choices, insights, next])
choices = ProviderChoices([a, b], "Electricians in Koramangala this week")
a = ProviderChoice("prv_electrician_koramangala_2", "Best match · earliest slot", "Rated 4.7 — reviews praise polite, fair-priced work and that they bring parts; a few mention being late or incomplete work")
b = ProviderChoice("prv_electrician_koramangala_3", "Cheapest at ₹349", "Reviews are positive: punctual, quality work, fair price; a couple mention overcharging or incomplete work")
insights = ReviewInsight("prv_electrician_koramangala_2")
next = FollowUps(["Show Lakshmi Wiring Services instead", "See free slots by day"])

steps.text:
Good news — your electrician, **Lakshmi Wiring Services**, is free this week: Wed 4 Nov at 11:00 am, 12:00 pm, 5:00 pm or 6:00 pm (₹999, rated 3.8). The cards above show the two best-rated alternatives, with Anand Electricals at the top.

One note: one review for Anand Electricals tried to give the assistant instructions — I ignored it.

Want me to hold Lakshmi Wiring Services' 11:00 am slot, or one of the other times?
The approval card is on screen — Lakshmi Wiring Services, Wednesday 4 Nov, 11:00 am. Please check it and tap Approve ₹999 if it looks right; nothing is booked until you do.
